title: Haze: Air quality improves nationwide, unhealthy readings in four areas of Sarawak - The Edge Malaysia
text:
Haze: Air quality improves nationwide, unhealthy readings in four areas of Sarawak Wednesday 28 Oct 2026 BURSA SGX Home 
 Make The Edge Malaysia your preferred source on Google KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 26): Four areas in Sarawak recorded air pollutant index (API) readings at an unhealthy level as of 5pm on Monday, with the monitoring station at the Serian district police headquarters recording the highest reading at 156.
 According to the Department of Environment’s Air Pollutant Index Management System (APIMS) portal, three other areas that also recorded unhealthy levels were Sibu (152), Sarikei (152), and Kuching (130).
 Meanwhile, 32 areas recorded good air quality, while another 32 areas recorded moderate API levels.
 API readings between zero and 50 are categorised as good, 51 to 100 as moderate, 101 to 200 as unhealthy, 201 to 300 as very unhealthy, while readings exceeding 300 are categorised as hazardous.
